data.name: Raihanaht
data.gender_notes: Raihanaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic 'Ra'ihan', meaning 'garden, pleasant, sweet'. The name Raihanaht is a beautiful, gentle name, evoking images of a lush, blooming garden, and the sweet fragrance of its flowers. The name Raihanaht carries the meaning “Gentle, sweet, garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raihanaht usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, sweet, garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner garden of the heart, a place of growth, beauty and peace. It is a reminder to nurture oneself, and to keep one's heart open to the beauty of the world and the love of others.
data.etymology: Raihanaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, sweet, garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raihanaht total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
